q: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the sign-in page, click "Forgot password". We'll email you a reset link that expires after 30 minutes. Let me know if you run into any trouble!

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan costs $4 per month and includes unlimited notes and up to 3 devices. Annual billing saves 20%.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: Team is $8 per user per month, so 5 people would cost $40 per month. Annual billing saves 20%.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: On the Free plan, you can keep up to 100 notes on 1 device. If you need more, the Plus plan offers unlimited notes and up to 3 devices for $4 per month.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: Yes! Plus subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase, and you're at day 10, so you qualify. Just contact support@example.com with your order number, and we'll take care of it. We reply within one business day.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: Unfortunately, refunds are only available within 14 days of purchase, and three weeks is beyond that window. If you have special circumstances, you're welcome to contact support@example.com with your order number, and they'll do their best to help.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: No, there's no Linux desktop app. However, Linux users can use Example Notes through any modern web browser. Let me know if you have any other questions!

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: No, the Android app requires Android 12 or later. However, you can use the Example Notes web app in any modern browser on your device instead.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: No, the web app requires an internet connection. However, the mobile and desktop apps work offline and sync automatically when you reconnect. If you need offline access, I'd suggest using one of those apps instead.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: Go to Settings > Export and choose PDF to export all your notes. The export will be emailed to you as a ZIP file.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: Don't worry! Deleted notes stay in the Trash for 30 days, so yours is still there. Just open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore" to get it back.

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: No, SMS codes are not supported for two-factor authentication. Example Notes only supports authenticator apps, which you can set up under Settings > Security > Two-factor authentication.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: On the Free plan, attachments are limited to 25 MB per file. If you need more, Plus and Team plans allow up to 250 MB per file.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: No, you keep your paid features until the end of the current billing period. To cancel, go to Settings > Billing > Cancel plan.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: Your notes are stored in AWS data centers in the United States. All data is encrypted both at rest and in transit. Let me know if you have any other questions!
